summary: Campbell's filed a routine Form 8-K reporting an Extension Agreement, effective September 16, 2026, under its $1.85 billion Five-Year Credit Agreement dated April 16, 2024, with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. as administrative agent. The amendment simply extends the facility's maturity from April 16, 2030 to April 16, 2031; all other terms remain unchanged. No board recommendation, advisor, price, stake, or ownership terms are implicated. This is an ordinary credit-facility extension, not a special situation, with no deal or risk-arb angle to monitor.
